scripts.text: You adventurers are always one some kind of adventure, aren't you? I mean, that's the very definition of the word.
scripts.translation: 你們冒險者總是在進行某種冒險，不是嗎？畢竟，這就是這個詞的定義。

scripts.text: You're such a nice young man. I will remember your name. I would much appreciate it if you would also remember mine.
scripts.translation: 你真是個不錯的年輕男子。我會記住你的名字。如果你也能記住我的名字，我會非常感激。

scripts.text: I am known as Kino Kitty. I am a wandering poet who wishes to rediscover wishes and dreams.

scripts.text: Ah, it is a privilege to meet a noble woman such as yourself. By your leave, I shall give you my name.
scripts.translation: 啊，能結識像您這樣高貴的女士是我的榮幸。請允許我向您介紹我的名字。

scripts.text: My lady, fair as wisteria, whose beauty rivals that of the goddess Freya, let me introduce myself as the poor poet who wanders the earth, Kino Kitty. I hope you remember me.
scripts.translation: 美麗如紫藤的女士，您的美貌可與女神芙蕾雅相媲美。請允許我自我介紹，我是流浪於大地的貧窮詩人，基諾·基蒂。希望您能記住我。

scripts.translation: 約爾蒂試著不再哭了，因為那樣會讓基諾叔叔難受，然後他會咳出更多的血。

scripts.text: I miss my mommy a lot, but I'm worried, it makes Uncle Kino worry a lot too.
scripts.translation: 我很想念媽媽，但我擔心這樣會讓基諾叔叔也很擔心。

scripts.text: I don't see my mommy and daddy aren't here anymore, and I don't want Uncle Jorti to go away either.
scripts.translation: 媽媽和爸爸都不在了，我也不想讓基諾叔叔離開。

scripts.text: U-Uncle Kino says we can't go see her yet because there are no flying boats yet...
scripts.translation: 基...基諾叔叔說我們還不能去看她，因為還沒有飛艇...

scripts.text: Jorti is going to enjoy Uncle Kino's songs and stories for as long as she can!
scripts.translation: ..約爾蒂不再哭了！約爾蒂要儘可能長久地享受基諾叔叔的歌和故事！

scripts.text: The songs Uncle Kino sings are ones that my mommy used to sing. She's not here, but maybe we can visit her someday!
scripts.translation: 基諾叔叔唱的歌是媽媽以前常唱的。雖然她不在了，但也許有一天我們可以去見她！

scripts.text: Hey... The shiny black cross on your hand means you're a friend of Uncle Kino's. So that means, you're my friend too!
scripts.translation: 嘿...你手上那個閃亮的黑色十字架，說明你是基諾叔叔的朋友。那也就是說，你也是我的朋友！

scripts.text: Jorti tries not to cry anymore because it hurts Uncle Kino and then he coughs up more blood.
scripts.translation: 約爾蒂試著不再哭了，因為那樣會讓基諾叔叔難受，然後他會咳出更多的血。

scripts.text: I miss my mommy a lot, but when I'm worried, it makes Uncle Kino worry a lot too.
scripts.translation: 我很想念媽媽，但當我擔心的時候，基諾叔叔也會很擔心。

scripts.text: My mommy and daddy aren't here anymore, and I don't want Uncle Jorti to go away either.

嗯...抱歉，這是一場私人演出。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but this is a private performance. This song is only intended for my little Jorti.
scripts.translation: 這首歌只唱給我的小約爾蒂聽。

scripts.text: Well, did you find what you were seeking for? Although all we have are old, dusty books, I hope you come by to visit. And please give my regards to your Bard friends.
scripts.translation: 那麼，你找到你尋找的東西了嗎？雖然這裡只有些落滿灰塵的舊書，但我還是希望你能常來坐坐。另外，請代我向你的詩人朋友們問好。

scripts.text: You have a black cross seal on your hand. Is Kitty still around? I'm glad to see he's still alive. If you're a friend of his, then you are most welcome here.
scripts.translation: .你手上有一個黑色的十字印記。基諾·基蒂還在附近嗎？很高興看到他還活著。既然你是他的朋友，那麼這裡歡迎你。

scripts.text: Well, well, well. You're here again. So, what kind of books are you seeking today? Of course, all we have are old, dusty tomes full of eddas. Hahahaha~
scripts.translation: 哎呀，哎呀，哎呀。你又來了。那麼，今天你想找什麼樣的書呢？當然，我們這裡只有些落滿灰塵、寫滿埃達集的舊書。哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text: You must be looking for something special. Well, we have almost every Norse poem, or 'edda.' This is the only place where you can find those kinds of old songs.
scripts.translation: 你一定是在尋找什麼特別的東西吧。嗯，我們這裡幾乎收藏了所有的北歐詩歌，也就是“埃達集”。這裡是唯一能找得到這類古老歌謠的地方。

scripts.text: However, I cannot show these fragile books to just anybody. For the sake of preservation, I can only show these works to preferred customers.
scripts.translation: 不過，我不能把這些脆弱的書籍隨便展示給任何人看。為了儲存它們，我只能向特定的顧客展示這些作品。

scripts.text: Ah~! You must be the friend of a high ranking Bard! I see, I see. You must be a friend of Minty Errende.
scripts.translation: 啊~！你一定是位高階詩人的朋友！我明白了，我明白了。你一定是薄荷·艾倫德的朋友。

scripts.text: So, what is it that you're looking for? Well, I suppose I don't really need to ask that. Hahahaha~

scripts.text: Well, your heartbeat is a little faster than normal. You might want to look into that. You know, for the sake of your health?

scripts.translation: 你是在找醫療或健康方面的書嗎？很抱歉，我們這裡沒有這類書。

scripts.text: You must be looking for something special and rare. But we only carry one kind of book around here.

scripts.translation: 這是一首情歌。每個人一生中至少都會經歷一次單戀的痛苦。
